snippet.title: Low-Budget Repairs - Premiere Trailer
snippet.description:
🚧 Watch the NEWEST trailer for Low-Budget Repairs!

Just 6 days to go until release! 🤩 Wishlist now so you don’t miss the big day! 🤞
🔗 https://store.steampowered.com/app/3167920/LowBudget_Repairs

Manage renovations in 90s apartment blocks! Focus on quick profit and cut costs wherever possible. Client notices defects? Tough luck, the money's already in your pocket. Every day brings new challenges and decisions that can lead to fortune... or trouble! 🏚️🔧

#LowBudgetRepairs #Simulator #IndieGame
